For riders who train and race exclusively on clincher-compatible wheels, the Pista Control Clincher provides the speed, grip, and efficiency of Vittoria’s world-class track tyres without compromise.

Why Choose the Pista Control Clincher?

Until now, clincher track tyres have typically been limited to training use, with tubulars remaining the gold standard for racing. The Pista Control Clincher changes that, offering genuine race-winning performance in a clincher format.

With a CRR of 0.001816, it is significantly faster than traditional clincher training tyres and competes directly with many top tubulars. This means you can run clincher wheels in competition without sacrificing efficiency — an option that was virtually unheard of before the release of this tyre.

The Continental GP5000 TT TR is a specialist time trial tyre on the road — but it has also proven itself as one of the fastest tyres ever used on the track. With a CRR of just 0.001503, it delivers exceptional rolling efficiency and has been the choice of record-breakers including Dan Bigham and Filippo Ganna, who used this tyre to set new UCI Hour Records.

The tyre has also been adopted by the Danish national track cycling team, who fitted the GP5000 TT TR across their fleet of Canyon track bikes, further cementing its status as a world-class option for elite track racing when paired with tubeless-compatible clincher wheels.

Key Features at a Glance

CRR of 0.001503 – faster than most tubulars, with proven record-breaking pedigree

Tubeless-Ready clincher design – can be run tubeless or with a tube

Black Chili compound – Continental’s premium rubber for low rolling resistance and grip

Vectran Breaker – lightweight puncture protection

Why Choose the GP5000 TT TR?

The GP5000 TT TR bridges the gap between road and track racing — a tyre engineered for time trials, but proven at the very highest level on indoor velodromes. With its low rolling resistance and advanced tubeless design, it offers record-level efficiency and responsiveness.

It is especially attractive to riders and teams running modern clincher/tubeless track wheelsets, where it provides race-day speed without compromise.

Vittoria Pista Oro Tubeless (CRR 0.001208)
: The outright fastest tubeless track tyre, designed specifically for indoor velodromes.

Continental GP5000 TT TR (CRR 0.001503)
: Slightly slower, but versatile across both track and road, and proven in hour record attempts.

Vittoria Pista Speed / Control (0.001406 / 0.001579)
: Tubular-only options for riders on traditional track wheels.

In short: The GP5000 TT TR is not marketed as a track tyre, but its use by Ganna, Bigham, and the Danish team proves it’s more than capable at the very highest level.

description:
The Vittoria Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready represents the pinnacle of track tyre innovation. Building on the legacy of the Pista Oro tubular — Vittoria’s fastest ever tyre — this tubeless-ready version pushes performance to the next level with an even lower CRR of just 0.001208, making it the most efficient track tyre ever produced.

Used by powerhouse national teams including Great Britain and the Netherlands at the Paris Olympics, the Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready is already proven at the very highest level of the sport.

Whether in individual pursuit, team pursuit, kilo, or record attempts, this tyre delivers the ultimate combination of speed, responsiveness, and reliability on indoor wooden velodromes.

Key Features at a Glance

Vittoria’s fastest-ever track tyre – now in tubeless-ready format

Ultra-low CRR of 0.001208 – the lowest rolling resistance ever measured on a Vittoria track tyre

320 TPI Corespun casing – supple, lightweight, and responsive with added durability

Available sizes: 700x23c (187g) and 700x25c (192g)

Classic para sidewall finish

Can be run tubeless or with a tube

Not compatible with hookless rims

Designed exclusively for indoor wooden velodromes

Why Choose the Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready?

Every watt counts in track racing, and the Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready provides the lowest rolling resistance of any track tyre in the world. With a CRR of just 0.001208, it outperforms even the Pista Oro tubular (0.001390 / 0.001260 TPU), giving riders a measurable edge in events where victory is decided by hundredths of a second.

For More Information on Coefficient of Rolling Resistance (CRR) in Track Cycling, Click Here

It is not designed for versatility — it is designed for pure, uncompromising speed. This makes it the tyre of choice for:

Individual & Team Pursuit

Kilo / 500m Time Trial

Flying 200m Qualifiers

Hour Record & World Record attempts

Vittoria Pista Oro Tubeless vs. Pista Oro Tubular

Pista Oro Tubular
(180g / 149g TPU)
: Already exceptionally fast, with CRR values of 0.001390 (standard) and 0.001260 (TPU). Favoured for traditional setups with tubular wheels.

Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready (187g / 192g)
: Slightly heavier, but achieves an even lower CRR of 0.001208 thanks to tubeless technology. Offers the ultimate in rolling efficiency and responsiveness, provided you are running compatible tubeless track wheels. This is the future of Track Cycling

In short: Choose
Pista Oro Tubular
for proven performance on tubular wheels. Choose Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready if you want the absolute cutting edge in speed and rolling efficiency.

Tubular vs. Tubeless – What’s the Difference?

Tubular
: Lightweight, glued onto a tubular rim. Still the standard in track racing, widely used across all disciplines.

Tubeless-Ready
: Mounts onto a clincher-style rim with a sealed tubeless setup or can be used with a tube. Provides lower rolling resistance and improved ride quality, but requires compatible equipment.

The Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready is not compatible with hookless rims.

Which Size Should You Choose – 23mm or 25mm?

The 23mm option is the preferred choice for most riders and professional teams, as its narrower profile delivers the lowest CRR (0.001208) and optimal aerodynamic efficiency. The 25mm version offers slightly more comfort and stability but comes with a small increase in rolling resistance. For pure speed and maximum efficiency on indoor velodromes, 23mm is the recommended size.

Tubeless Tyre Pressure Optimisation

Indoor Wooden Tracks (Recommended use case):

Sprinters: 120 psi

Endurance riders: 110 psi

As with all high-performance tyres, always adjust pressure to track conditions, rider weight, and rim compatibility.

Technology Explained

Graphene Compound
: Vittoria’s most advanced rubber technology, optimised for track applications to reduce rolling resistance while maintaining cornering grip at speed.

320 TPI Corespun Casing
: Combines lightweight cotton with durable aramid fibres for an ultra-supple ride feel, vibration reduction, and improved resilience.

Tubeless-Ready Bead
: Allows riders to run the tyre either tubeless (for ultimate efficiency) or with a traditional inner tube.

Event Suitability

The Vittoria Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready is designed exclusively for elite indoor velodrome racing and excels in:

Individual Pursuit

Team Pursuit

Kilo / 500m Time Trial

Flying 200m/Match Sprint

Hour Record & World Record attempts

It has already proven itself in Olympic competition, used by Great Britain and the Netherlands at the Paris 2024 Olympics, cementing its reputation as the pinnacle of track cycling tyre technology.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the Vittoria Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready the fastest track tyre?
A: Yes. With a CRR of just 0.001208, it has the lowest rolling resistance of any Vittoria track tyre to date.

Q: Can I use the Pista Oro Tubeless with a tube?
A: Yes, it is tubeless-ready and can also be run with a standard tube setup.

Q: What’s the difference between the tubeless and tubular versions?
A: The tubeless-ready version achieves an even lower CRR (0.001208 vs. 0.001390 / 0.001260 TPU tubular) but requires compatible tubeless rims.

Q: Can I use this tyre outdoors?
A: No. Like the Pista Oro tubular, it is designed exclusively for indoor wooden velodromes. For outdoor racing, consider the Vittoria Pista Control Tubular.

Q: Is it compatible with hookless rims?
A: No. The Pista Oro Tubeless-Ready is not suitable for hookless rim designs.

The Coefficient of Rolling Resistance (CRR) is a critical measure of efficiency, showing how much energy is lost as a tyre rolls. A lower CRR means:

Faster acceleration

Higher top speeds for the same power output

More efficient energy transfer

The Vittoria Pista Speed has a proven CRR of just 0.001406, putting it ahead of most competing track tubulars, which typically test in the 0.0020–0.0025 range. This means fewer watts are wasted — a decisive advantage when Olympic medals are decided by fractions of a second.

Q: Is the Vittoria Pista Oro the fastest track tubular?
A: Yes. With CRR values as low as 0.001306, it is the fastest Vittoria tubular ever made, optimised for indoor velodrome racing.

Q: What’s the difference between the Pista Oro and Pista Speed?
A: The Pista Oro is faster but less versatile, designed exclusively for indoor boards. The Pista Speed is slightly less efficient but more affordable, durable and widely used across both timed and bunch events.

Q: Should I choose the Standard or TPU version?
A: The Standard (180g, CRR 0.001390) is already incredibly light and efficient. The TPU version (149g, CRR 0.001306) is even lighter and faster, but comes at a premium.

Q: Can I use the Pista Oro outdoors?
A: No. It is designed only for indoor wooden velodromes. For outdoor use, choose the Vittoria Pista Control Tubular.
